title: Fetch repository history for CI contract guards

source.ref: LIVE-2288 exact-head checks: check:shipped-ids failed because the checks runner had no origin/main ref.

detail:
The checks job now requests complete Git history so repository guards that scan merged IDs and migration history have origin/main and its ancestry. The lint and test jobs retain their shallow checkouts. This changes CI checkout evidence only; no runtime code, migration, key-event setting, probe baseline, or product flag changes.

CI contract guards now run with complete main history; the base-fetch consequence probe passes.

CI contract guards now have complete main history; the checked-out-base consequence probe passes.
